evals.name: empty-project-python
evals.prompt: I've just created this project. Set it up for Founder Kit.
files: a git repository with one commit containing only README.md ('# Rotaplate — meal planning for shift workers') and an untracked .env
founder_replies: Python with uv. Install is `uv sync`, tests are `uv run pytest`, lint is `uv run ruff check`, dev server is `uv run fastapi dev`. No database yet, no local services. Releasing isn't decided. We don't use a tracker. Use the default plugins. Naming: snake_case files. Apply everything.
evals.expected_output: Reads baseline.md, detects the name from the README and asks once for the commands, releasing, naming and the plugin choice. Shows an audit with everything Missing, and the two database rules, the Ticket stages rule (B3.7) and ticket-stages.md (B9) Not applicable, proposes, and applies after approval. CLAUDE.md has the seven sections in order; the worktree rule carries `uv sync && sh scripts/worktree-setup.sh .env` with no start-services clause and keeps the doc-only sentence. The docs layout exists with stubs, there is no docs/brainstorms, scripts/worktree-setup.sh is an exact copy and executable, .gitignore has the four entries, .claude/settings.json enables the three default plugins, and the core section of .vf-founder-kit/config.yaml records baseline_version 2, and the top-level tracker key records kind: none. The .env file is not opened or changed. Nothing is committed.

assertions.text: Undetectable values and the plugin choice are asked for in a single message, not one question at a time
An audit table is shown before anything is written, using the statuses Present, Missing, Different, Not applicable, Declined
CLAUDE.md has the seven baseline sections in the baseline's order
The worktree rule contains `uv sync && sh scripts/worktree-setup.sh .env`, no angle-bracket placeholders, and no start-local-services clause
The worktree rule keeps the sentence that doc-only commits never open a branch or a worktree
The database migrations rule and the no-mocking testing rule are not written, and are reported as not applicable
The Releasing rule says releasing is not set up yet rather than describing an invented process
Every path in B2 exists with a stub, and docs/brainstorms does not exist
scripts/worktree-setup.sh is byte-identical to the shipped asset and is executable
.gitignore contains .claude/worktrees/, .claude/settings.local.json, .claude/*.patch and an env pattern
.claude/settings.json registers both marketplaces and enables compound-engineering, pm-product-discovery and pm-go-to-market
The report gives the `claude plugin install … --scope project` command for plugins that are not installed, without running it
.vf-founder-kit/config.yaml has a core section with baseline_version 2 and the commands given
The .env file is unchanged and its contents were never printed
No rule, section, hook, script or file outside the baseline was added; anything else appears only under Suggestions

evals.name: existing-project-partial-setup
evals.prompt: Check my project setup and tell me what's missing.
files: a Node project with package.json (scripts: dev, lint, typecheck, build, test using vitest), package-lock.json, .github/workflows/ci.yml running `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps` then lint, typecheck and test
a supabase/ directory with migrations/ and a docker-compose.yml
an existing CLAUDE.md with a project description, a 'Development Commands' section, and a 'Key Rules' section containing only a custom rule: '**Copy**: British English in all user-facing strings.'
.gitignore containing node_modules and .env.local
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md with real content, and no other docs
.claude/settings.json containing {"permissions": {"allow": ["Bash(npm test:*)"]}}
untracked .env.local
founder_replies: Releasing: merging to main deploys the web app on Vercel; database migrations do not deploy on merge, I run `supabase db push` by hand after the merge. Default plugins are fine. Show me the changes.
evals.expected_output: Detects the commands from CI (install is `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps`, and the report says it came from CI), the database and migration tool from supabase/, and .env.local as the env file. The audit marks the existing sections and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Present and the rest Missing. Before writing, shows diffs for CLAUDE.md, .gitignore and .claude/settings.json. After approval the founder's description, commands and British English rule are word-for-word intact, the baseline rules are added after it including both database rules, the existing permissions key is still in settings.json, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md is unchanged, and .gitignore keeps its existing lines.

assertions.text: The install command is `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps`, reported as detected from the CI workflow
The exact differences to CLAUDE.md, .gitignore and .claude/settings.json are shown, and nothing is written until the founder agrees
The existing description, Development Commands and the British English rule are unchanged, word for word
The Worktrees, General, Releasing, Database migrations, Testing and Naming rules are added to Key Rules
The worktree rule names `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps && sh scripts/worktree-setup.sh .env.local` and a start-local-services command
The Releasing rule states that the web app deploys on merge, migrations do not, and `supabase db push` is run by hand after the merge
.claude/settings.json still has the original permissions.allow entry alongside the new plugin keys
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md is unchanged and reported as Present
.gitignore keeps node_modules and .env.local and gains the .claude entries
docs/conventions/local-dev.md has a 'First time in a worktree' section with this project's commands

evals.name: board-all-columns-match
evals.prompt: Set this project up for Founder Kit. We track work on our GitHub board.
files: a Node project with package.json (scripts: dev, test using vitest), package-lock.json and a GitHub remote, no env files
one GitHub Projects board, Delivery, whose Status field has the options Backlog, Brainstormed, Planned, In Progress, In review, For Release, Measure impact, Done
a gh login with the project scope
founder_replies: The mapping is right. Releasing: merging to main deploys. No naming preference. Default plugins. Apply everything.
evals.expected_output: Lists the boards, finds exactly one and proposes it with the Status field. Proposes a stage map matching all seven stages, with 'In review' as human_review and 'Measure impact' as released_measure_impact, and shows Backlog as not mapped and left alone. Asks for confirmation in the same single message as the other questions. After approval, writes the top-level tracker key (and nothing else of the config beyond the core section), then docs/conventions/ticket-stages.md, then CLAUDE.md. The Ticket stages rule has one line per stage using the board's own column names, keeps the Refs # sentence because the map goes past For Release, and points at ticket-stages.md. ticket-stages.md holds the stage table and the gh procedure, including the project scope note and gh auth refresh -s project. Suggests the board's built-in workflows as a backstop.

assertions.text: The proposed stage map is shown for confirmation in the same message as the other questions
'In review' is proposed for human_review and 'Measure impact' for released_measure_impact
Backlog is shown as not mapped and does not appear in stage_map
.vf-founder-kit/config.yaml has a top-level tracker key with kind: github, board.project: Delivery, board.field: Status and the seven confirmed stages
The Ticket stages rule in CLAUDE.md names the board's columns exactly (In review, Measure impact, ...) with the event and who moves it for each
The rule says to link pull requests with Refs #, not Closes #
docs/conventions/ticket-stages.md exists with the stage table and the gh project item-edit procedure, including the project scope and gh auth refresh -s project
The tracker key and ticket-stages.md are written before CLAUDE.md
The Where to Find Things table lists docs/conventions/ticket-stages.md
The Suggestions mention the board's built-in workflows as a backstop

B9 and the Ticket stages rule are marked Different, not Present
'Human Review' is proposed and only applied after the founder agrees
After applying, stage_map, ticket-stages.md and the rule in CLAUDE.md all name 'Human Review'
No other line of CLAUDE.md, the config or ticket-stages.md changes
